hero.subtitle: Six AI agents clean your data, model it, define your KPIs and build your dashboard. Every number comes with its proof, and you can always ask why.

demo.aria: Animated example: a question, the agents at work, a misleading comparison caught and the honest answer.
demo.question: Revenue by state: August vs July?
demo.caught_text: August data stops on the 23rd: comparing it with a full July would be unfair.
demo.footer: Real figures from the Olist dataset · 16 decisions in the audit journal

how.title: From raw file to trusted insight in three steps
how.subtitle: No SQL, no pipeline to build, no modeling to learn. You bring the data and the question.

drop.title: Drop your CSV
drop.text: Askboard profiles your file, detects personal data, missing values and outliers, and cleans it with versioned rules.

ask.title: Ask in plain words
ask.text: “Revenue by state, August vs July?” The agents understand your business vocabulary and pick the right KPI.

trust.title: Get a dashboard you can trust
trust.text: Misleading comparisons are caught before you see them, and every figure links back to its source.

agents.title: Six agents, one orchestrator
agents.subtitle: Each agent does one job well, writes its decisions in a shared journal, and hands its work to the next.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.text: Profiles the data, flags anomalies and personal data, cleans with a versioned playbook.

etl.title: Data engineering
etl.text: Ingests and transforms the file into a clean, typed warehouse.

semantic.title: Semantics & KPIs
semantic.text: Understands business terms and defines dimensions, measures and KPIs.

analyst.title: Analyst
analyst.text: Computes the answer and finds the insight behind it.

dashboard.title: Dashboards
dashboard.text: Chooses the right chart and refuses misleading comparisons.

auditor.title: Auditor & explainability
auditor.text: Explains every decision, keeps a tamper-proof journal and watches for drift.

agents.orchestrator_text: runs the agents in the right order, in parallel when it can, and stops when a human must decide.

trust.title: Numbers you can question
trust.subtitle: A dashboard is only useful if you can believe it. Askboard shows its work.

compare.title: Honest comparisons
compare.text: Incomplete periods, different lengths or populations are detected and a justified fix is proposed. You decide.

explain.title: Explained decisions
explain.text: Why was this payment flagged? SHAP shows what pushed the model, in plain words.

journal.title: Tamper-proof journal
journal.text: Every decision is chained with SHA-256. Change one line and the chain breaks.

bo1.title: Faster time-to-insight
bo1.text: From raw data to a usable answer in minutes, not weeks.

bo2.title: Automated governance
bo2.text: Deterministic rules and agent supervision remove routine human errors.

bo3.title: Explainability & audit
bo3.text: A natural-language rationale and a log entry for every transformation and KPI.

bo4.title: BI for everyone
bo4.text: Managers get their own dashboards without waiting for an engineer.

cta.title: Ready to ask your data?
cta.text: Create your account and run your first analysis on a prepared dataset in under a minute.

run.not_found: This analysis does not exist or is not yours.
run.failed: The pipeline could not complete this analysis. Check that the Python API is running, then try a new analysis.
run.wait_pipeline: The results appear when the pipeline is done.

cmp.kept: Comparison kept as asked, despite the warning
cmp.misleading: This comparison is misleading as asked
cmp.as_asked_text: Show the comparison you asked for, knowing it is biased.
cmp.journaled: Your choice is written in the audit journal. Nothing is applied without it.
cmp.waiting_text: The dashboard is not drawn while the comparison is misleading. Choose an option above.
cmp.chart_error: The dashboard could not be loaded.
cmp.chart_note: {kpi} by {dim} · computed in SQL from the KPI catalog · periods: {source}. Temporary chart: Samar's dashboard agent replaces it.

shap.none: No SHAP explanation for this data.
shap.intro: Why did the profiler flag these rows? Each bar shows how much a variable pushed the model toward an anomaly (amber) or toward normal (teal).
shap.error: The explanations could not be loaded.

journal.chain_text: Each entry contains the hash of the previous one: changing or deleting any line breaks the chain.
journal.data_prep_text: Written by the other agents when the dataset was prepared.

drift.monitor_text: Each month is compared with 6 reference months to tell “the data changed” from “an agent changed”.
drift.monitor_empty: Run the drift simulation on the Python side to see the monthly monitoring.

why.title: Ask why
why.subtitle: The auditor agent investigates the journal and the reports, then answers with its sources. Every number is checked.
why.s2: Where does the figure “{kpi}” come from?
why.s3: Which decisions were made on this analysis?
why.error: The agent could not answer. Please try again.
why.placeholder: Ask a question about these figures…
why.not_owner: Only the owner of this analysis can ask.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: All your analyses, with their status and your decisions.
history.confirm: Remove this analysis from your history? The audit journal keeps its decisions.
history.note: Removing an analysis only hides it from your history: the audit journal is append-only and keeps every decision.
